image_description: A large adult Australian Pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus) standing on grassy ground next to a small, dark-feathered chick. The adult has white plumage with black flight feathers, a long pinkish bill with a prominent gular pouch, and blue-grey webbed feet. The chick is significantly smaller, covered in dark brown/black down, standing to the right of the adult.
